facts.text: The hotel was originally built as a palace and then converted into a Waldorf Astoria hotel.
facts.excerpt: Did you know that Waldorf Astoria Jeddah - Qasr Al Sharq was originally built as a palace then it was converted to be the smallest Waldorf Astoria in the world ?

facts.text: Guests arrive under a three-story Swarovski chandelier.
facts.excerpt: Arrive to elegance under a three-story Swarovski chandelier and wake up to views of Jeddah.

facts.text: The hotel is adorned with gold accents, Italian furnishings and crystal.
facts.excerpt: Adorned with gold accents, Italian furnishings, and glistening crystal, our hotel is an oasis on the Red Sea.

facts.text: Each suite has golden ceilings, marble bathrooms and a view of the Red Sea.
facts.excerpt: Each suite exhibits golden ceilings, marble bathrooms, and a view of the Red Sea.

facts.text: Rooms and suites mix modern and Arabic interior design.
facts.excerpt: Lounge in exquisite rooms and suites that feature a mix of modern and Arabic interior design.

facts.text: The Qasr al Sharq suite covers half of an entire floor.
facts.excerpt: Covering half of an entire floor, the vast Qasr al Sharq suite is nearly 1,000 square meters.

facts.text: The Qasr al Sharq suite includes two master bedrooms, a formal majlis and a private health club.
facts.excerpt: The ravishing suite includes two master bedrooms, a formal majlis, a private health club, and more.

facts.text: The Qasr al Sharq suite comes with personal butler service and a balcony with Red Sea views.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy your personal butler service while taking in stunning Red Sea views from the balcony.

facts.text: The hotel has two restaurants: Mataam Al Sharq for Middle Eastern cuisine and Aromi for Italian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in both Middle Eastern and Italian cuisines at our two restaurants, Mataam Al Sharq and Aromi.

facts.text: Al Shurfa Lounge serves coffee, tea and pastries for a quick breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Need a quick breakfast? Visit Al Shurfa Lounge for coffee, tea, and pastries.

facts.text: Al Shurfa Lounge serves afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: Experience our luxury afternoon tea at Al Shurfa Lounge, with a selection of delicious desserts

facts.text: The spa is reserved for women and offers mind and body healing services following holistic methods.
facts.excerpt: Our ladies-only spa provides a variety of mind and body healing services following holistic methods.

facts.text: The spa offers an AquaMed Hydrotherapy bed.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to try our AquaMed Hydrotherapy bed for ultimate relaxation.

facts.text: Spa treatments include custom spa rituals, deep cleansing facials and Thai massages.
facts.excerpt: We offer custom spa rituals, deep cleansing facials, Thai massages, and more.

facts.text: The spa uses Clarins for facials, exfoliations and body wraps.
facts.excerpt: Clarins Facials, Exfoliations & Body Wraps

facts.text: The hotel offers personalized butler service and an EV charging station.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy personalized butler service and modern amenities including an EV charging station.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: Pets not allowed

facts.text: The hotel is on North Corniche Road in Jeddah.
facts.excerpt: North Corniche Road,

facts.text: The hotel has meeting rooms equipped with a business center.
facts.excerpt: Plan your next event or meeting at Waldorf Astoria's luxurious meeting rooms equipped with a fully-fledged business center

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports the hotel was designed by the firm behind Dubai's Burj Al Arab.
facts.excerpt: Designed by the firm behind Dubai’s Burj Al Arab and managed by the Waldorf-Astoria Collection hotel chain

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel's scalloped archways, carved arabesques and layers of brocade.
facts.excerpt: With scalloped archways, carved arabesques, and layers of brocade

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports the spa has a lap pool under a retractable glass roof.
facts.excerpt: has an Aquamedic lap pool under a retractable glass roof.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the smallest Waldorf Astoria in the world.
facts.excerpt: converted to be the smallest Waldorf Astoria in the world

facts.text: The hotel has 38 rooms and suites.
facts.excerpt: Waldorf Astoria Jeddah – Qasr al Sharq features 38 rooms and suites that are designed to impress.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel has 46 suites.
facts.excerpt: Some of the 46 suites exceed 10,000 square feet

contradictions.note: Official rooms page says 38 rooms and suites; Conde Nast Traveler says 46 suites
